Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please review the continuous-control row in the Q1 2028 board packet draft `doc_q1_2028_board_evidence` and post a readiness-review comment. Explain how the blank outcome-window field should be handled, identify the other metadata that must be present, and state whether the row can remain marked ready while any required input is incomplete.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_q1_2028_board_evidence", "body": "Readiness review — CS auto-nudge continuous-control row

The blank outcome-window field must not remain blank. Because this is a continuous-control row, enter exactly: “not applicable — continuous control coverage”. The row should instead be anchored by its exact coverage dates, currently October 1–December 31, 2027.

The other required metadata that must be present before readiness is assessed are: measurement limits; exclusions; source owner; source or release-reliability evidence; revenue and forecast treatment; and final claim owner. These fields need substantive, traceable entries—not placeholders—so the packet states what the evidence covers, what it does not establish, who owns the source and final claim, how reliable the source/release is, and whether revenue or forecast treatment is excluded or otherwise defined.

The row cannot remain marked “ready” (including “tentatively ready”) while any required input is incomplete. With the outcome-window field and all of the listed metadata currently blank, change the readiness status to not board-ready / incomplete pending owner completion and review."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_172_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment must state that this continuous-control row requires exact coverage dates and that its outcome-window field must be set exactly to `not applicable — continuous control coverage`, rather than being left blank or treated as a customer-outcome cohort window.

The comment must identify all remaining mandatory row metadata categories: measurement limits, exclusions, source owner, source or release-reliability evidence, revenue and forecast treatment, and final claim owner. Missing or materially substituting any category fails.

The comment must direct that the row be marked `not board-ready` and must not remain ready or tentatively ready until every required input is complete.", "value": {"doc_id": "doc_q1_2028_board_evidence", "body": "Readiness review — CS auto-nudge continuous-control row

The blank outcome-window field must not remain blank. Because this is a continuous-control row, enter exactly: “not applicable — continuous control coverage”. The row should instead be anchored by its exact coverage dates, currently October 1–December 31, 2027.

The other required metadata that must be present before readiness is assessed are: measurement limits; exclusions; source owner; source or release-reliability evidence; revenue and forecast treatment; and final claim owner. These fields need substantive, traceable entries—not placeholders—so the packet states what the evidence covers, what it does not establish, who owns the source and final claim, how reliable the source/release is, and whether revenue or forecast treatment is excluded or otherwise defined.

The row cannot remain marked “ready” (including “tentatively ready”) while any required input is incomplete. With the outcome-window field and all of the listed metadata currently blank, change the readiness status to not board-ready / incomplete pending owner completion and review."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_172_02","passed":true,"reason":"The comment requires exact coverage dates (“October 1–December 31, 2027”), directs the outcome-window entry exactly as “not applicable — continuous control coverage,” lists every mandatory category (measurement limits, exclusions, source owner, source or release-reliability evidence, revenue and forecast treatment, and final claim owner), and states the row “cannot remain marked ‘ready’ (including ‘tentatively ready’)” and must be changed to “not board-ready / incomplete” until completion and review."}]}
